item.title: MegaFon Tajikistan Upgrades 4G Network, Expands Fiber Infrastructure
item.summary: MegaFon Tajikistan upgraded 47 base stations, expanded LTE coverage, strengthened its fiber transport network, and enhanced its core infrastructure during the first half of 2026, according to the operator’s latest network update.
